hook.text: Its maker called it the end of an era, and its themes were inspired by films including Yojimbo and Seven Samurai.

sentences.text: Denzel Curry first started picturing the album's themes in 2018, and he got to work on it once he had finished Zuu, his 2019 album.
In May 2020, Curry told XXL that he planned to retire from music after three more full-length projects.
Melt My Eyez stands for the way people dodge hard subjects in daily life, and See Your Future is about moving on from the past and looking ahead.
He also talked about setting aside some old alter egos in favor of speaking as himself.
Nathan Burgess handled the mixing and engineering, and Chris Gehringer did the mastering.
Robert Glasper played keyboards and A-Trak is credited as a sampler.
Thundercat, Bridget Perez, Anna Wise and Buzzy Lee added vocals, while Denzel Curry is the only one credited for rap vocals.
In June 2022, a remix of 'Walkin' with Key Glock became the first single for an extended version of the album.

The extended edition arrived on 30 September 2022 with ten new songs, recorded by Curry with the Cold Blooded Soul Band, plus two songs that had never been released: 'Larger Than Life' and 'Chrome Hearts', which features Zacari.
A livestream concert, Melt My Eyez: Live From the Komodo City Cafe, was held on 29 September to promote the album.

listen_for.text: It contains a sample of 'The Loving Touch', which Keith Mansfield wrote and performed.
It contains a sample of 'Come Closer', as performed by Salma Agha.
It contains a sample of 'Nothing Left to Do', as performed by After All.
It contains a sample of 'Amen, Brother', as performed by the Winstons, and Slowthai is the featured guest.
